scope.eligibility: v6 label output.status == complete, minus the three explicitly quarantined exp_ids
scope.count_unit: eligible checkpoint records, not verified distinct weight hashes
scope.weight_deduplication: not performed in this audit; handled by separate checkpoint inventory
scope.further_eligibility_note: Source-code review and exact recipe/checkpoint/tokenizer bindings can further reduce eligibility.

conditions: Stock versioned provider behavior; no unrecorded environment/server/request overrides.
Counts describe generation-config contributions, not empirically distinct accuracy outcomes.
Per-prompt context capacity and platform caps are not folded into nominal max_tokens.

rules: Load JSON as Transformers 4.57.3 GenerationConfig and conceptually apply to_diff_dict: a field equal to the HF constructor default is removed.
vLLM imports only five sampling fields and max_new_tokens; ignore null imported values and fill missing sampling fields with vLLM defaults.
Map max_new_tokens to the server default max_tokens cap; nominal cap is min(benchmark request cap, non-null configured max_new_tokens).
Positive temperatures below 0.01 clamp to 0.01; temperature 0 neutralizes top_k/top_p/min_p to 0/1/0.
Normalize top_k=-1 to 0; these both disable filtering. All other values remain distinct.
Normalize generation_config.eos_token_id int/list to a sorted unique list, but do not claim this is the final effective stop set.
Effective EOS stopping additionally uses the primary tokenizer EOS. Runtime request stop IDs and ignore_eos can change it.
normalization.note: The listed ignored JSON fields do not establish that tokenizer/model metadata elsewhere is irrelevant.

selection_recommendation.purpose: Predictor feasibility under a controlled serving protocol, not finding the accuracy-maximizing decoding config.

dominant_core.screen: At least 50 eligible records and at least 20 trajectories; chosen at the observed prevalence breaks, not a statistical significance threshold.

supported_extension.screen: At least 10 eligible records and at least 3 trajectories; broader support screen, not a requirement to evaluate every combination.

optional_mechanism_probe.rationale: Greedy AIME has only 8 eligible records across 4 trajectories, but complements the stochastic AIME core with a distinct decoding mechanism.

unsupported_previous_proposals: GSM temperature 0.3 with top_k64/top_p0.95 has no exact eligible sampling/cap support; observed temperature0.3 examples disable top_k.
AIME temperature0.6/top_k20/top_p0.95 at cap2048 has no exact eligible sampling/cap support; all54 observed cap2048 examples use temperature1 and no filtering.
AIME baseline repetition penalty1.1 has 3 records; repetition penalty1.05 has22, making1.05 the support-grounded extension.
selection_recommendation.no_allocation_commitment: This audit selects candidate policy support only. The final 1000-cell checkpoint selection is a separate artifact; no generic fixed checkpoints-by-policy allocation is assumed here.

standardization.interpretation: Use the same intended effective stop set within each benchmark. This is an explicit new intervention where historical stops differed, not historical replay equivalence.
tokenizer_requirements: Pin the exact tokenizer artifact/hash and explicit benchmark prompt/chat template.
Validate that token ID mappings and special-token semantics are compatible with the checkpoint weights. Do not silently replace an incompatible tokenizer.
If using the planned stop-token union with ignore_eos=false, require the tokenizer primary EOS to be a member of that union; otherwise reject or explicitly revise the policy before scheduling.
Validate BOS/padding/template tokenization separately; generation_config bos_token_id/pad_token_id are not a substitute.
standardization.preferred_override_strategy: Run vLLM with generation_config=vllm and supply the complete per-request sampling/cap/stop policy from openai_request_payload. Alternatively replace the whole generation_config payload and set matching request caps; never rely on partial inherited patches.
standardization.warning: Disabling generation-config loading also removes its EOS contribution, so supply planned stop_token_ids explicitly. A request max_tokens=16000 alone does not defeat an inherited max_new_tokens=2048.
standardization.seed_schedule: Use a pinned, recorded ten-repeat seed/scheduling protocol, assigned by the final execution plan.
standardization.actual_context_cap: Preflight model/tokenizer context lengths and prompt lengths; record actual per-request max_tokens after all caps.

historical_reuse.reason: Matching settings alone is insufficient; this audit has not verified exact weights, effective tokenizer/EOS, prompt/context cap, runtime/server overrides or ten-pass protocol against every historical run.
historical_reuse.rule: Reuse an existing ten-pass label only after all full-cell inputs and protocol match. Otherwise a replay consumes one cell; record old and new labels separately.
historical_reuse.cost_guidance: Do not rerun every historical baseline merely to fill the grid. First verify reuse eligibility and reserve a small representative protocol-check subset; actual replay choices belong in the final 1000-cell manifest.
historical_reuse.ten_pass_definition: Mean pass@1 over ten complete benchmark runs, not pass@10; ten repeats are not ten independent recipe training examples.
